settings.title: Discover the Stories Behind the Pages

settings.editor: Growing up surrounded by books, I developed a love for stories that transport, inspire, and connect. Writing became my way of sharing that magic. Over the years, I’ve been fortunate to transform my passion into a career, crafting tales that resonate with readers across the globe.

settings.title: "Stories have the power to bridge hearts and inspire change."

settings.editor: For me, writing is about more than just creating stories; it’s about forging connections. Each book is a journey—of discovery, emotions, and shared human experiences. My goal is to create narratives that linger in your heart long after the final page.

settings.description_text: People you feel like you’ve known forever
Stories that tug at your heartstrings

settings.editor: When I’m not writing, you can find me exploring quaint bookstores, sipping tea by the window, or traveling to seek new inspirations. These everyday moments shape the stories I create.

icon_list.text: I’ve visited 30+ countries to research my novels.
I collect vintage journals as keepsakes.
I believe every story begins with a cup of tea.
